payload.title: File:Trilophosuchus skull reconstructed.png
payload.description_html: A skull reconstruction of Trilophosuchus (QM F16856), scalebar 2cm. The posterior section of the skull was reconstructed based on the better preserved side of the fossil to account for postmortem crushing and distortion altering the shape of certain elements. The purely hypothetical snout shape (after Willis 1993) is colored grey to highlight that this area is subject to a greater degree of speculation.
